index.demo_done_text.en: You got {correct} of {total} right on the first try and earned {xp} XP. That's how every lesson feels for our learners.

index.demo_idle.en: Tap the answer you think is right.

index.demo_intro.en: Many of our learners are just starting to read, so every question comes with a picture and a speaker button. Here are three real questions from our English course. Wrong answers are fine: just try again.

index.demo_title.en: See a lesson through a learner's eyes.

index.feature_abc_text.en: The English course begins with the alphabet and builds up to full sentences.

index.feature_audio_text.en: A speaker button reads questions and words out loud.

index.feature_languages_text.en: Menus and help appear in the learner's own language, including right-to-left scripts.

index.feature_retry_text.en: A wrong answer turns red and the learner simply picks again. Nobody has to start over.

index.game_garden_text.en: Right answers water your garden. Plant seeds and watch them bloom.

index.game_match_text.en: Find the pairs, like a capital letter and its small letter.

index.game_potion_text.en: Choose a recipe, pick the right ingredients and brew a potion.

index.game_rocket_text.en: Answer quick questions to fuel your rocket and blast off.

index.game_storm_text.en: Pick out the right words before the storm blows them away.

index.games_lead.en: Many lessons are played as games, so practice doesn't feel like a test. Every right answer moves the game forward.

index.hero_lead.en: IntegratED is a youth-to-youth learning programme in Athens. Student volunteers from ACS Athens meet young refugees supported by The Home Project, and they learn side by side with an app made for people who are just starting to read.

index.hero_learner_link.en: Sign up with your invite code

index.involve_heading.en: There's a place for you here.

index.involve_lead.en: IntegratED runs on young people who show up for each other. Here's how you can be part of it.

index.involve_learn_text.en: Young people at The Home Project join with an invite code from their teacher.

index.involve_support_text.en: Donations help the programme grow and reach more young people.

index.involve_volunteer_text.en: Students at ACS Athens sign up with their school's invite code and get paired with a learner.

index.meta_description.en: IntegratED is a youth-to-youth learning programme in Athens: student volunteers and young refugees learning side by side, with an app built around pictures and sound.

index.mission_detail.en: Many of the young people we work with had their schooling interrupted, and some are learning to read for the first time. IntegratED helps them find their way back into learning, with someone their own age by their side.

index.mission_statement.en: We believe learning together builds bridges between languages, cultures and young people.

index.photo_1_alt.en: Two teenagers reading and using a tablet together

index.photo_2_alt.en: A girl helping a boy with his homework

index.photo_3_alt.en: Two teenagers looking at a tablet together

index.session_1_text.en: A volunteer and their learner meet up for their session.

index.session_2_text.en: They open the learner's next lesson together: a quiz or one of five games.

index.session_3_text.en: Tap the speaker, repeat the words, and try again when something is tricky.

index.session_4_text.en: Both log the session. The learner earns XP, levels up and unlocks new looks for their character.

index.session_lead.en: Two young people, one lesson and plenty of encouragement.

index.who_heading.en: The people at the heart of IntegratED.

index.who_learners_tag.en: Young refugees supported by The Home Project

index.who_learners_text.en: Many had their schooling interrupted, and some are reading for the first time in any language. Here they can start with pictures and sound, at their own pace.

index.who_teachers_tag.en: The people who run the programme

index.who_teachers_text.en: They pair learners with volunteers, keep track of every session and hand out worksheets.

index.who_volunteers_text.en: They give their time to meet a learner, practise together and be a friendly face along the way.

index.design_lead.en: Every part of IntegratED assumes a learner might not read yet, and might not speak English yet either.

index.photo_session_alt.en: Two young people laughing together while working on a tablet
